stemLabel: OZ — winger has it on the wall, weak-side D dropped to the net

interaction.prompt: Tap the open ice to attack.

feedback.right: The defenceman is standing in the net-front, so it's covered. The open ice is the weak side they vacated.
feedback.wrong: The weak-side D dropped to the net, so the net-front is exactly where the coverage is. Attack the space they left — the weak side.

tip: If a defender is at the net, the net isn't open. Read where they came FROM — that's the open ice.
why: Reading the off-puck defender tells you which ice is actually open. A body at the net means attack the space it vacated, not the net itself.
